items.prompt: What does source_sha256 in this loader identify?

options.text: The exact original input bytes used in this run
options.why: The digest is computed before decoding or normalization.

options.text: The verified legal owner of every price
options.why: A byte hash does not authenticate an owner.
The synthetic schema is declared separately.

options.text: Every external service the user has authorised
options.why: No account or permission data is involved in this loader.

items.explanation: The hash helps reproduce and compare byte identity. Source authenticity, truth and permissions need separate evidence.
